generation_rules: Use first-person declarations of identity and spiritual roles
Invoke divine or ancestral figures by name and title
Describe movement over symbolic landscapes (waters, heaven)
Express humility and reverence in speech
pause_rules: Pause after repeated phrases to allow reflection
Pause between invocations of different divine figures
original_extraction.psychological_function: Promotes humility, reverence, and a sense of guidance or protection
repetition_rules: Repeat key identity phrases multiple times (e.g., 'I am a woman who looks into the insides of things')
Repeat sacred words (e.g., 'saint') in extended sequences
